title: Prescription Insurance on File — Plan Termination, New Coverage and Replacement Cards
content:
**Termination.** A plan held under **Prescription Insurance on File** is terminated on the day after the termination date the payer reports. Claims with a date of service after the termination date are rejected patient not covered, and the patient is asked for their new coverage, which is added as a new coverage record rather than written over the old one.

**Replacement card.** A new card for the same plan and member only updates the card details of the existing record.

**Billing order.** Changing a plan's billing order is an update of the record and must keep no two open records with the same order.

**Claims around the termination date.** Paid claims before termination stay as they are. A claim paid in error after termination is reversed under the reversal rules and re-billed.

## Dates around a termination (hypothetical: payer reports a termination date of 31 March)

| Item | Result |
|---|---|
| Day the plan is terminated | 1 April |
| Claim with a date of service of 31 March | Not after the termination date; not rejected patient not covered on this ground |
| Claim with a date of service of 1 April | After the termination date; rejected patient not covered |
| Claim dated 2 April that was paid in error | Reversed and re-billed |
| Claim dated 20 March, paid | Stays as it is |

## New plan or new card

| What the patient brings | Treatment |
|---|---|
| A new card for the same plan and the same member | Card details of the existing record are updated |
| Coverage from a new plan | Added as a new coverage record; the old record is not written over |
